# King's Blogs

> King's College London's institutional blog hosting platform providing a centralized space for academic, research, and student blogs across the university.

King's Blogs is a WordPress multisite platform that serves as the official blog hosting service for King's College London, enabling faculty, researchers, and students to publish and share scholarly content. The platform hosts a diverse range of academic and research blogs from various departments, centers, and initiatives across the institution.

- [King's Blogs – Blogs at King's College London](https://blogs.kcl.ac.uk): Homepage for King's Blogs, King's College London's institutional blog hosting platform
- [View our blogs – King's Blogs](https://blogs.kcl.ac.uk/home/view-our-blogs): Directory of King's College London academic, research, and student blogs
